business.text: Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) is India's largest private sector enterprise with business activities spanning energy and materials, digital services, retail, and media.
Reliance Retail operates 20,160 stores covering 78.3 million square feet of retail area, serving 387 million registered customers as of FY26.
Jio delivers digital and telecommunication services, ending FY26 with over 524 million digital subscribers.

bull.text: Net profit growth rebounded to 17.8% in FY26, alongside free cash flow rising to Rs.70,023 crore and cash from operations reaching Rs.1,92,113 crore.

bear.text: Borrowings reached Rs.4,02,962 crore in FY26, while interest cover declined steadily from 7.4x in FY22 to 6.6x in FY26.

The company's cash conversion cycle elongated to 25 days in FY26 from -8 days in FY25, alongside a drop in days payable to 84 days.
